sections.title: Web hosting
paragraphs: This website is published through METANET AG. To deliver and protect the website, the hosting provider may process technical connection data such as the IP address, time of access, requested resource, and browser information in server logs. For more information, see METANET's privacy notice.

sections.title: Google Analytics 4
paragraphs: We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand how visitors use this website and to improve it. Analytics runs by default when you visit the website. The service is provided by Google. Our measurement ID is G-GLZ0H84MBV.

GA4 can process page views, page addresses, referrer information, browser and device information, interaction data, and pseudonymous identifiers stored in first-party cookies. Google says that Google Analytics does not log or store raw IP addresses; it uses IP information to provide the service and derive general location information. Google explains the data collected by Analytics.

sections.title: Your analytics settings
paragraphs: You can turn analytics off or on at any time on this page under “Analytics settings”. Use the “Privacy & analytics settings” link in the footer to go directly there. Your choice is stored in your browser's local storage and is not sent to Google. If you turn analytics off, the site tells Google to stop analytics storage and does not send further page-view events. You can also clear this site's stored data in your browser.

sections.title: Google, transfers, and retention
paragraphs: When analytics is active, data is transmitted to Google. Google may process data on servers outside Switzerland. Information about Google's privacy practices and international data transfers is available in Google's Privacy Policy and Google's information about data transfers.
Google Analytics user-level and event-level data is retained according to the retention setting configured for this GA4 property. See Google's data-retention documentation.

sections.title: Questions
paragraphs: For questions about this website's use of Google Analytics or to make a privacy request, contact us at yoshi-moshi@yoshi-moshi.com.
